subject.title: perf(state): cap the per-agent SQLite handle cache with LRU eviction

question: Should the new `readOnly` mode on the plugin SDK `listSessionEntries` API become a supported external contract, or should the fleet-introspection implementation remain behind an internal/core-owned seam?
rationale: The optional flag is additive but changes the public plugin SDK surface and defines new lifecycle and lock-tolerance semantics that ordinary patch review cannot safely choose permanently.

options.title: Approve a documented SDK contract
options.body: Keep the additive mode after defining its no-create/no-register behavior, transient-error contract, and compatibility tests for external plugin callers.

options.title: Keep the read path internal for now
options.body: Avoid expanding the plugin SDK until an owner-approved API design is ready, while preserving the bounded-cache repair behind internal accessors.

recommendation.title: Keep the read path internal for now
recommendation.body: Avoid expanding the plugin SDK until an owner-approved API design is ready, while preserving the bounded-cache repair behind internal accessors.
